# Introduction

The **`outlierdetection`** analysis (Outlier Detection) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Outlier detection using multiple statistical methods from the easystats performance package. This module provides comprehensive outlier detection through univariate methods (Z-scores, IQR, confidence intervals), multivariate methods (Mahalanobis distance, MCD, OPTICS, LOF), and composite scoring across multiple algorithms. Complements existing data quality assessment modules with state-of-the-art outlier detection capabilities. Perfect for clinical research data quality control and preprocessing.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("outlierdetection_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::outlierdetection(
#   data = outlierdetection_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `outlierdetection` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
